title: Cohort
description: PROVISIONAL (pending founder WhatsApp handoff, 2026-08-12). A batch of people who move through an institution together: a programme plus an entry year (e.g. the B.Tech CSE batch that joined in 2024). Sections and classes within a cohort are Spaces that point back here.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this record's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

institutionId.description: Id of the Institution this cohort belongs to.

label.description: How people name this cohort in speech (e.g. 'B.Tech CSE 2024', 'MBBS 2023 batch').

programme.description: The programme of study (e.g. 'B.Tech Computer Science', 'B.A. Economics').

entryYear.description: Calendar year the cohort joined the institution.

expectedGraduationYear.description: Calendar year the cohort is expected to graduate.
